_purpose: Training domain of the network and the default model of the guarded predictor (src/sfp/predict.py). Written by scripts/derive_domain.py from the training split; do not edit by hand.

basis.p_psia: training band of the sampling window (log-uniform draw); the 2000-4000 psia band was used only for the extrapolation test
basis.z: minimum and maximum of each mole fraction over the training rows. The checks are marginal: a state can pass every range and still be a combination the training data never covered

configuration_implied_z_range.rule: integer mole charges 1-40: one component at the minimum with the other six at the maximum, and the reverse

review_limits_checked.pressure: confirmed: training band ends at 2000 psia; the extrapolation test covers 2000-4000 psia
review_limits_checked.composition: the stated 0.004-0.87 is the range the configuration allows (0.00415-0.86957); the training rows contain only 0.0048-0.4756 (per component 0.427-0.476 at the top), so the realised ranges are used

default_checkpoint.rule: lowest best validation data MSE among the six reported models (results/metrics/train_*.json); no test data used
